items.name: Application check
items.desc: We read your completed application and supporting documents and tell you in plain language what is missing, unclear or inconsistent, before you submit it.
includes: Review of your application and documents
A written list of fixes, in order of importance
Official sources named for every point

items.name: Document preparation help
items.desc: We work through your document list with you: what to gather, how to present it, and what to check on each item. You submit your own application; we never file on your behalf.
includes: Review of each document you send
Up to two rounds of feedback
Official sources named for every point

items.name: 30-minute planning call
items.desc: A live call to talk through your trip, your documents and your questions. You leave with a clear next-steps list. General information only, not legal or immigration advice.
includes: Next-steps list sent after the call

items.name: Guide: Morocco paperwork for a first trip
items.desc: A step-by-step guide to what to prepare before you go, with the as-of date and official source for each rule. Unlocks in My purchases.

items.name: Guide: your document checklist
items.desc: A printable checklist of the documents travellers commonly need to prepare, with what to double-check on each. Unlocks in My purchases.

items.name: Walkthrough: filling in the online application
items.desc: Follow along, screen by screen, as the online application is completed: which answers need care, and what to have to hand. Unlocks in My purchases.
includes: What to have to hand before you start
